passages.note: House Third Reading; Wilmeth voted Y on final passage of HB2853.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Enacted text added by the bill Wilmeth voted for: any student eligible to attend public school becomes a qualified student for an ESA, i.e. universal eligibility.
Bill status page lists Wilmeth as a co-sponsor; the governor signed the bill as Chapter 388.

rows.reasoning: Wilmeth co-sponsored HB2853 (2022) and voted Y on its House Third Reading (31-26-3-0-0); the enacted law added A.R.S. 15-2401.01, making any student 'eligible to enroll in a public school' a qualified student for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account, with no further eligibility limit. This matches rung 5, "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family."
